title: RYPEN (Rotary Youth Program of Enrichment)
summary: RYPEN stands for the Rotary Youth Program of Enrichment.
description:
RYPEN stands for the Rotary Youth Program of Enrichment. It is a personal development and leadership camp organized by Rotary districts and local Rotary clubs for the students aged 14-17.
Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim organized RYPEN 2026 on 6
th and 7
th October at Neral Vidya Mandir.
About 70 Students from 7 nearby schools attended the programme along with their teachers. A team
of 21 members from RCMM participated in RYPEN.
The theme “Discover, Develop and Lead” was woven into the activities and interactions throughout
the event.
➢ Discover: Identify your talents, strengths and potential.
➢ Develop: Build skills, confidence and a positive attitude.
➢ Lead: Take initiative, inspire others and contribute to society.
location: Neral Vidya Mandir, Neral, Mumbai, Maharashtra
